explication: Chipyard is a Chisel-based framework for configuring and generating RISC-V SoCs, with supporting FPGA harnesses, FireSim simulation, and tapeout memory-macro compilation. The main workflow is configuration into a generated chip/system, then binding its ports and clocks to a simulation or FPGA harness. The README documents additional cores, accelerators, memory systems, and hardware flows, represented here at subsystem level where source was not sampled. Edges are limited to relationships shown in excerpts or documented in the README; unsampled subsystem wiring is not inferred.
